description: This PHP test source file contains unit tests for the AbstractLeaveAllocationService class within the OrangeHRM leave management system. It defines test methods for addHoursDuration and getDurationInHours functionalities, including data providers for different test cases, and utilizes mocking to test protected methods.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AbstractLeaveAllocationService, testing addHoursDuration and getDurationInHours methods with data-driven tests.

methods.name: testAddHoursDuration
methods.description: Tests the addHoursDuration method by verifying the resulting time after adding specified hours.

methods.name: getAddHoursDurationDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test cases for testAddHoursDuration with different start times and hours to add.

methods.name: testGetDurationInHours
methods.description: Tests the getDurationInHours method by asserting the duration in hours between two datetime objects.

methods.name: getDurationInHoursDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test cases for getDurationInHours with varying start and end times.
